Jobs sent to your phone. Billing handled. You keep 90%.

We run a dispatch desk for boat owners in Pinellas, Hillsborough and Pasco. Owners post jobs, we screen them, and we offer each one to the two or three best-matched mechanics. You accept the ones you want.

  • Free to join. No monthly fee, no lead fees.
  • You set your rates and edit every quote before it goes out.
  • Decline anything. No penalties.
  • We collect from the customer by bank or card and pay you 90% when it clears, usually within a week. No chasing invoices.
  • Upload any invoice, a photo of a paper ticket is fine. We read it.

What we ask

  • Commercial general liability insurance ($1M), certificate on file
  • W-9 before your first payout
  • Your own truck, tools, and parts sourcing
  • Call the customer within the hour when you accept a job
  • Written quotes, and honor them
  • Customers we introduce run through the platform for 12 months

You remain an independent business. Read the customer terms and ask for the technician agreement before you accept your first job.
